NATIONAL WAGES CONSULTATIVE COUNCIL ACT 2011

MINIMUM WAGES (AMENDMENT) (NO. 2) ORDER 2013

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 23(2) of the National Wages

Consultative Council Act 2011 [Act 732], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation

1. This order may be cited as the Minimum Wages (Amendment) (No. 2)

Order 2013.

Amendment of paragraph 2

2. The Minimum Wages Order 2012 [P.U. (A) 214/2012], which is referred to as the

"principal Order" in this Order, is amended in paragraph 2—

(a) in subparagraph (1A), by substituting for the word "Schedule" wherever

appearing the words "First Schedule"; and

(b) in subparagraph (4), by substituting for the word "Schedule" the words

"First Schedule".

Amendment of paragraph 3

3. Paragraph 3 of the principal Order is amended by inserting after subparagraph (3)

the following subparagraph:

"(4) This Order shall not apply to local employees employed by the

employers specified in column (1) of the Third Schedule for the period specified

in column (3) of the Third Schedule.".

New Third Schedule

4. The principal Order is amended by inserting after the Second Schedule the

following Schedule:

"THIRD SCHEDULE
